paite: TOUPA thu ka kiang ah ahong tung a, ka kiang ah,
heading: Mikhial Unau Numeite

paite: "Mihing tapa, numei nih, nu khat ta a-om uhi.
Aigupta gam ah ahukmang ua, atuailai neu ua huk ahi ua, huai ah a-angnem uh azawtsak ua, atuailai nawi uh ameksak ek uhi.
Khat, a-upapen min Oholah ahi a, asanggamnu bel Oholibah ahi; huan kei a ahong hita ua, tapate tanute asuang ua. Amin uh, Oholah pen Samaria ahi a; Oholibah bel Jerusalem ahi.
Huan Oholah kei a ahih nung in ahukmang nawn a, adeihtak, a-invengte, Assuria anou a;
ukpipate, vaihawm mite, tangval iplahhuai mahmah ngen, sakol tungtuangmi, puan sandup a kizemte.
Hiai Assuria tangval hoihte tengteng lak ah akiphal vek ua, a-etlahte milim tengteng in akihihnin nawn behlap hi.
Atuailai neu a kipan anawite ameksak uh leh akithuahpih ziak un Aigupta a kipan in ahukna atawp tuan kei a, amau leng ahukna uh atung uah ahih pichin uhi.
Adeihtakte, Assuria, anouhnouhte khut ngei ah ka mansak ahi.
Hiaite'n avuaktanna alemdawk ua, atanu leh atapate alaksak ua, amah leng namsau in athat ua, numeite lak ah akikhemlauna pen uh ahong hita a, ama tung a gel bang amualsuahta hi.
"Huan asanggamnu Oholibah in hiai amu a, himahleh a-unu sang in adeihtak nouhnouhna ah a-uangzaw in, ahukna a-uang semsem lai hi.
Assuria mi, invengte gam ukpipa leh vaihawmpa tangval etlahhuaitak ngen, sakol tungtuangmi, kilawmtak a kivante anounou hi.
Hihnit in a-om chih ka mu a, anih un lam kibang atawn uhi.
"Huchi in ahuknate a-uangsak sem a, baang a pasal lim tuang, Kaldai mite lim, san-au tak a kizem, em,
akawng ah kawnggak agak a, dial kilawmtak khim in, avek ua milian bang in, Kaldai gam, apianna gam ua Babulon mite bangtakte amuh ziak in.
Amau amuhtak in anounou a, akiang uah Kaldai pha in mi asawl hi.
Huchi in Babulon mite akiang ah, kingaihna lupna ah ahong pai ua, ahukna un ahihnin ua, akihihbuah khinta ua, amau amah anel mahmah uhi.
Huchi in ahukna ahihlang a, avuaktanna alemsak a, asanggamnu a pan ka kiheisan bang in amah ka kiheisanta hi.
Himahleh atuailai a Aigupta gam a ahuk lai atheihgige ziak in ahuk semsem hi.
A-angkawmpihte van, sabiltung a bang mai ahi a, athilpawtte leng, sakolte a thilpawt bang mai ahi.
Huchibang in na tuailai hukna Aigupta min na tuailai nawite ahon khoihsak lai na theikhe nawnta ahi."
Huaiziak in aw Oholibah, hichibang in Toupa PATHIAN in achi hi: "Ngai in, nang hon it, na lungsim in anelsate ka tamsak ding a, kil chih a kipan ka pikhawm ding.
heading: Sanggamnu Nauzaw Tung A Pathian Thukhenna

paite: Babulon mite leh Kaldai mi tengteng, Pekodte, Shoate, Koate leh akiang ua Assuria mite tengteng toh; tangval etlahhuai taktakte, ukpipate, vaihawm mite, avek un miliante leh minthangte, avek un sakol tung a tuang in ahong pai ding uhi.

Galvante, kidouna kangtalaite, kangtalaite leh mipi omkhawm in ahong sual ding ua; lum lian leh lum neu, dal lukhute toh na kim ah ahon um ding ua; akiang uah vaihawmna ka kemsak ding a, athugel bang zel un na tung ah ahihtangtung ding uhi.

Huan na tung ah ka lung hihlouhna ka tungsak ding a, heh mahmah in nang ahon sual ding ua, na nakte leh na bilte asatkhe ding ua, akhosuaksunte namsau in asi ding uh, na tanu leh na tapate ahon laksak ding ua, akhosuaksunte mei in akanglum ding uh.
Na puansilhte ahon hawksak lai ding ua, na kizepna kilawm taktakte alamang ding uh.
Na hukna leh Aigupta gam a kipan a na kizuakna ahon tawpsak ding ua, huchi in amau lam ah na mit na lengsak nawn kei dia, Aigupta gam na theigige nawn kei ding hi.”
Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi ngal a: "Ngai in, na huat mahmah, nang hon chimtakte khut mahmah ah ka hon mansak ding.
Huat petmah in ahon ho ding ua, na sepgim gah tengteng ahon laksak ding ua, vuaktang in kihawmkhai in ahon taisan ding uh; na kizuakna vuaktanna, na hukna leh na kizuakna ngei hihlat in a-om ding hi.
Hiai thilte na tung ah ahong tung ding, namdangte delh in na hukmang ding a, amilimte ua na kihihnit ziak in.
Na sanggamnu lampi na tawn sam a, huaiziak in amah nou na khut ah ka hon pe ding."
Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: "Na sanggamnu nou thuk leh lian na dawn ding a, nuihsan leh simmoh in na om ding;
Khamna leh lungkhamna in na dim dia, lamdangsakna leh siatna nou, na sanggamnu Samaria nou toh na dawn gai keuhkeuh ding hi.
Na dawn ding a, anou leng na tawpsiang vek ding; na sam na botkhe dia, na nawite na hamkek ding. Kei, Toupa PATHIAN in ka chita hi."
Huaiziak in Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: "N'on mangngilh a na hon na dal ziak in na hukna leh na kizuakna moh na po mai ding hi."
Huai lou leng TOUPA'N ka kiang ah agen nawn a, "Mihing tapa, Oholah leh Oholibah na langsin ahia? Akihhuaina uh akiang uah puang in.
heading: Sanggamnute Tung A Pathian Thukhenna

paite: Ang akawmta ua, akhut uah sisan abang a, amilim kiang ah ang akawmta uhi; atapate uh kei a dia asuan uh akiang ua kangmang ding in mei ah apai uhi.
Huai lou in leng, ka kiang ah hiai achi uhi; amau mah in ka Mun Siangthou ahihnin ua, ka Sabbathte leng abohsia uhi.
Amilimte uh a dia atate uh athah nung un, amau mah in ka mun siangthou hihnin ding in alut ua; ngai in, hichibang in ka insung mahmah ah ahih uhi.

"Huai lou leng, gamlapi a pan mi hong pai ding in na thukhak ua, mi na sawl ua, ngai in, ahong ua, amau hel in na kisilsiang a, na mit na nuh a, kizephoihna dangte na silh a, lupna thupitak ah na tu hi.
Ama ah dohkan na bawl a, ka gimlim leh ka sathaute huai ah na lui hi.
Huai ah mipi noptal husa zak ahi a, mi namai kia lou leng gamdai a kipan in zukhamte ahon pi ua, anih un taute abun ua, lukhu kilawmte akhu uhi."
Huan ke'n, "Angkawmnu tek nung a kithuahpih nuam un, ama'n leng angap peuhmah diam maw?" ka chi hi.
"Huchi in kizuak kiang a ahoh bang un akiang ah alutta thou ua; huchi in numei huk Oholah leh Oholibah kiang ah alutta uhi.
Himahleh midiktatte'n angkawmnute leh sisan suah hat numeite vai ahawm bang un ahawmsak ding ua, angkawmnute ahih ua, akhut ua sisan aban ziak in."
Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: "Na tung uah mipi ka kaikhawm ding a, ka hon loksak ding a, ka hon bawlsak ding hi.
Mihonte'n suang in adeng ding ua, anamsau un asatlum ding ua, atanute uh, atapate uh athat ding ua, a-innte uh ahalsak ding uh.
Hichibang in hukna gam a kipan ka hihmang ding a, numei tengteng in na hukna uh chin louh hial ding ahi chih na theihna ding un.
Huchi in na tung uah na hukna uh ahon thuk ding ua, na milim khelhnate uh na thuak ding uh, kei Toupa PATHIAN ka hi chih na thei ding uh," achi hi.
